srli a0, a0, 37
li t0, 1
and a0, a0, t0
# Result: a0 = 0

# Test Case Rule: RULE 162: If the MPRV bit in mstatus is set and the MPP field in mstatus contains the value S or U, then PMP checks are applied to data accesses performed while the processor is in M-mode.

li t0, -1
csrw pmpaddr0, t0
li t0, 0x8
csrw pmpcfg0, t0
li t0, 0x1800
csrc mstatus, t0
li t0, 0x20800
csrs mstatus, t0
lbu a0, 0(sp)

# Test Case Rule: RULE 163: When NMIE is 0, the hart behaves as though the MPRV field of mstatus is cleared, regardless of the actual setting of mstatus.MPRV.

li a0, 0x5a
sb a0, 0(sp)
li t0, -1
csrw pmpaddr0, t0
li t0, 0x8
csrw pmpcfg0, t0
li t0, 0x1800
csrc mstatus, t0
li t0, 0x20800
csrs mstatus, t0
li t0, 0x8
csrc mnstatus, t0

lbu a0, 0(sp)

# Test Case Rule: RULE 164: If the MNRET instruction changes the privilege mode to a mode less privileged than M, then mstatus.MPRV MUST be set to 0.

li t0, 0x1880
csrc mnstatus, t0
li t0, 0x800
csrs mnstatus, t0
la t0, rule164_after
csrw mnepc, t0
li t0, 0x20000
csrs mstatus, t0
mnret
rule164_after:
nop
# Result: mstatus[17] = 0
